name: bluepencil
description: Prose analysis for writers: echoes, repeats, rhythm, dialogue, readability, and more

bluepencil.lsp.enable.description: Try to launch the bluepencil-lsp language server for live inline diagnostics. Falls back to CLI-based checks on save if the server is unavailable.

bluepencil.lsp.path.description: Path to the bluepencil-lsp binary. Resolved via $PATH if not absolute.

bluepencil.cli.path.description: Path to the bluepencil CLI binary. Resolved via $PATH if not absolute.

bluepencil.cli.enable.description: Run CLI-based checks on save (used when the language server is disabled or unavailable).

bluepencil.cli.commands.description: bluepencil subcommands to run on save for inline diagnostics. Each must support --json with a findings array carrying file/line/column (the 'list' style commands: adverbs, passive, cliches, filter, hedges, tics, nominal, overused, etc.). Commands with a different JSON shape (e.g. echoes) are not supported here.
